subject: Duplicate clone identification is possible with Poppr program? What codes have to use for it

messages.author: bc6aaaa25ff9a3a0
messages.subject: Duplicate clone identification is possible with Poppr program? What codes have to use for it
parts:
Could poppr identify duplicates between 2000 lines and also true-to-type (genetic fidelity) between field and invitro/tissue-culture collection?
I have large 40 SKP dataset and 2000 accessions. Is poppr package analyze this much 40 K SNPs and 2000 accessions analysis?
What Is SNP and taxa limit for poppr?
What are the codes used for Duplicate analysis?

Looking for your kind support and help.
Best Regards
Rajneesh

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Duplicate clone identification is possible with Poppr program? What codes have to use for it
parts: > Could poppr identify duplicates between 2000 lines and also true-to-type (genetic fidelity) between field and invitro/tissue-culture collection?
Poppr can identify both identical and near-identical clones (See our 2015 paper: https://www.frontiersin.org/articles/10.3389/fgene.2015.00208/full)
> I have large 40 SKP dataset and 2000 accessions. Is poppr package analyze this much 40 K SNPs and 2000 accessions analysis?
You should be able to do so using a snpclone/genlight object
> What Is SNP and taxa limit for poppr?
This is limited to the memory on your computer
> What are the codes used for Duplicate analysis?

You'll want to look into multilocus genotype analysis https://grunwaldlab.github.io/poppr/reference/poppr-package.html#multilocus-genotypes

Hope that helps,
Zhian

Dear Zhian,

Thanks for the quick reply. I have a few more query
How I will decide the cutoff threshold for duplicates and near close relatives? Will this automatically decided by software based on some analysis?
Is popr software can use also population data based on geographical or structure analysis to identify duplicates more efficiently than without population data?

Pls give me suggestion about filter especially MAF threshold as per your experience. What maf value should use for colonal crops? We have genbank collection so dont want to use very high maf >0.05.
Is popr do data filter by default? Or I have to give filtered data for duplicate identification.

I have my data in both hapmap and vcf format.
Could you give me the R-codes for only duplicates analysis with population and without population data?
Any suggestion which I have taken care during analysis?

Is output will give me a list of duplicates group and unique lines? Or how to make duplicates lines group?

Thanks for your quick support and help.
